definition: A globally unique identifier for an instance of a planned process (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/COB_0000082) that assigns a phenological trait annotation to a target plant observation based on human observation of a plant or part of the plant.
User friendly definitions: The unique identifier of the phenophase status record in Phenobase.

definition: scientific name of the observed organism
User friendly definitions: The taxonomic name of the organism for which the record was made. Taxonomy follows that used in the source dataset.

definition: taxonomic rank of the scientific name
User friendly definitions: The taxonomic rank of the organism for which the record was made, usually genus, species or subspecies.

definition: The full scientific name of the family in which the organism is classified.
User friendly definitions: The taxonomic family of the organism for which the record was made. Taxonomy follows that used in the source dataset.

definition: The family name from GBIF using the scientificName as the source.
User friendly definitions: The GBIF harmonized....  taxonomic family of the organism for which the record was made.

definition: The full scientific name of the genus in which the organism is classified.
User friendly definitions: The taxonomic genus of the organism for which the record was made. Taxonomy follows that used in the source dataset.

definition: Normalized taxonomy search terms derived from available family genus species and scientificName values.
Human-readable trait label resolved from trait_urn during loading. Use the canonical label in traits.csv, e.g.  "open flower present" or "ripe fruit absent".
User friendly definitions: The name of the primary phenological trait in the Plant Phenology Ontology (PPO) to which the phenophase status record was assigned.

definition: Stable PPO identifier for the trait used as the canonical mapping key during loading. Use values such as PPO:0002333 instead of relying on label text.
User friendly definitions: The unique identifier of the primary phenological trait in the Plant Phenology Ontology (PPO) to which the phenophase status record was assigned.

definition: System inferred list of mapped traits with each trait separated by a pipe delimiter
User friendly definitions: The names of all phenological traits in the Plant Phenology Ontology (PPO) to which the phenophase status record is related. These are generally parent classes of the primary trait.

definition: The unique identifiers of all phenological traits in the Plant Phenology Ontology (PPO) to which the phenophase status record is related. These are generally parent classes of the primary trait.
User friendly definitions: The unique identifiers of all phenological traits in the Plant Phenology Ontology (PPO) to which the phenophase status record is related. These are generally parent classes of the primary trait.

definition: verbatim observation date
User friendly definitions: The date that the observation was collected in the field.

definition: year of the observation
User friendly definitions: The calendar year that the observation was collected in the field.

definition: day of the year.  Must be between 1 and 366
User friendly definitions: The day of year, ranging from 1 to 366, that the observation was collected in the field.

definition: latitude with precision up to 6 decimal places
User friendly definitions: The latitude at which the record was collected in the field. Datum follows that in the source dataset.

definition: longitude with precision up to 6 decimal places
User friendly definitions: The longitude at which the record was collected in the field. Datum follows that in the source dataset.

definition: coordinate uncertainty in meters
User friendly definitions: Need def - check iNat definition of this

definition: We are refering to the source from the data aggregator and not the source that dwc:datasetName or dwc:institutionCode refers to
User friendly definitions: The organization or data aggregation platform from which the record originated.

definition: occurrence ID of the observed organism
User friendly definitions: The unique identifier in the source dataset for the phenophase status record.

definition: An identifier for the dwc:Organism instance (as opposed to a particular digital record of the dwc:Organism). May be a globally unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.
User friendly definitions: The identifier in the source dataset for the individual organism for which the record was made. This identifer is designed to be unique in some data sources.

definition: An identifier for the observation site.
User friendly definitions: The identifier in the source dataset for the location at which the record was made. This identifer is designed to be unique in some data sources.

definition: A list (concatenated and separated) of identifiers or names of people, groups, or organizations responsible for recording the original dwc:Occurrence. The primary collector or observer, especially one who applies a personal identifier (dwc:recordNumber), should be listed first.
User friendly definitions: The identifier in the source dataset for the person by whom the record was collected. This identifer is designed to be unique in some data sources.

definition: Verbatim description of the trait
User friendly definitions: The term used in the source dataset to describe the phenophase.

definition: URL for the observation metadata hosted by the datasource.  For example https://www.inaturalist.org/observations/{observation_uuid}. This will resolve to a record.
User friendly definitions: The landing page at which the record can be found at its original source. This may include useful ancillary data not ingested to Phenobase.

definition: basis of record of oberserved organism.  See darwin core reference for values
User friendly definitions: The type of collection method used to capture the phenophase status record. These include "human observation", "herbarium specimen image" and "live plant image".

definition: Method of annotation process, either human or machine
User friendly definitions: The method by which phenophase status was determined, either directly by a human observer ("human") or image analysis by a machine learning model ("machine").

definition: URI landing page describing the model that was used.
User friendly definitions: Where annotation method is by machine, the landing page describing the version of the machine learning model that was used.

definition: A metric of accuracy for the annotations of all records (equivocal and unequivocal) based on expert, gold standard observations.
User friendly definitions: Where annotation method is by machine, the accuracy of the model in detecting presence of the trait for the taxonomic family of the organism for which the record was made. This metric is included because certain plant structures can be very difficult to detect or distinguish for some plant families (e.g. tiny flowers in grasses).

definition: The proportion of the number of low certainty annotations divided by all annotations for iNaturalist observations in the taxonomic family. A metric of how successful the annotation process for observations in that family.
A metric of accuracy for the annotations of only high certainty records based on expert, gold standard observations.
The number of records that were annotated at the taxon rank of family associated with the identified occurrence
"A score from 0-1 which represent a scaled probability of presence or absence of a trait"
a categorical description of the annotation outcome, in this case either "Detected" or "Not detected"
Certainy of machine observation (Low or High).  This corresponds to Equivocal (Low) and Uniquevicol (High)
Error messages from processing
